title: Translation as an agent
description:
Translation on publish runs from a stream on `LocalizationRequest` into a dispatcher that invokes the runner. Give it a definition; wake it from the feed; its rung replaces `languages.auto`. Whole-site translation becomes many wakes, one per Story and language, never one long run. Holds stay holds.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A publish translates into each configured language once.
- Whole-site translation is cut per Story and language.
- The dispatcher's direct invocation is deleted.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- translation-agent.feature: a publish wants and starts one run per language; a held translation flags once; whole-site translation queues one wake per Story and language.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Site backend: localization dispatcher replaced by the feed.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M4 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
